The [http://se.ifi.uni-heidelberg.de/ Software Engineering Group] at the Institute of Computer Science, [http://www.uni-heidelberg.de University of Heidelberg] has developed several plugins for UNICASE. 

===Independent plugins===

The following plugins can be used individually. This means that they can be installed separately from any other plugins. For each plugin, an individual update site exists.

 * [Trace_Client Trace Client]: Provides (semi-) automatic creation and usage of traceability links between requirements, work items and source code during development. The Trace Client integrates itself seamlessly into the Eclipse IDE and Subversive (plug-in for Subversion). The main features are: (semi-) automatic creation of traceability links, requirements impact analysis, traceability between requirements and code, progress or requirements implementation, graph visualization.

 * [Search]: Provides search functionality for UNICASE projects and is based on the EMF Query project of Eclipse. Enables searching for names and descriptions of model elements. Searches can be restricted by element type and regular expressions for search string.

 * [Duplicate_Projects Duplicate Projects]: Can duplicate/copy a project. Projects can automatically be shared with EMFStore Server.

 * [Glossary]: Provides the element 'GlossaryEntry'. The element 'GlossaryEntry' can be linked to any other element.

===Integrated plugins===

The following plugins can only be used together. This means that they are all integrated and cannot be installed separately. For all plugins, one update site exists.

 * [Use_Cases  Use Cases]: Provides advanced support for specifying use cases, especially new visualization of Flow of Events. 

 * [Test_Cases Test Cases]: Provides support for specifying test cases with included test steps. Results of test cases can be documents in test protocols. Test Cases can be linked to Use Cases.

 * [Metrics]: Provides various metrics for UNICASE projects. For example, user metrics (elements per user, action items per user etc.), element metrics (number of elements, elements per development phase etc.) and time frame metrics (elements created between two dates). Queries for metrics can be saved for later usage and results can be exported to Excel.

 * [Context_Completeness Context Completeness]: Provides support for identifying incomplete elements, e.g. isolated elements or elements missing certain mandatory links to other elements. Results can be saved for later usage and exported to Excel. The context of a particular element can be shown, which means all linked elements of the originating element with ability to directly navigate the linked elements.
